correctness.rationale: The environmental interior equations force x=x_* and y=y_* and exactly the stated resonance; the two strategy equations then force n_1+n_12=n_2+n_12=kappa, with 0<kappa<2 and the stated endpoints. Direct differentiation gives the displayed Jacobian. Independently of the quartic Hurwitz test, eliminate the environmental coordinates at a nonzero eigenvalue and scale the strategy perturbations by diag(p,q)^(-1/2). The resulting pencil is lambda^2 I+lambda D+K, with e=(sqrt(p),sqrt(q)), D=alpha e e^T and K=beta diag(pu,qr)+beta t e e^T. K is positive definite. Taking the Hermitian product with a pencil eigenvector yields a scalar quadratic with positive mass and stiffness and nonnegative damping, hence Re lambda<=0; zero-real-part roots require Dv=0 and Kv=omega^2 v. The line orthogonal to e has both coordinates nonzero and is an eigenspace of K exactly when pu=qr, equivalently x_*=y_* because pu=w(1-x_*) and qr=w(1-y_*). In that case the two eigendirections give precisely the imaginary pair and the damped quadratic. The five-variable characteristic determinant is lambda times the pencil determinant by the block determinant formula, extending the equality to zero; det K>0 proves the tangent zero is simple. Expanding the pencil gives the stated quartic and its squared Hurwitz difference. Differentiating each environmental logit cancels all terms in H dot; on the equilibrium curve H is strictly increasing and ranges from minus to plus infinity. Locally H is a regular coordinate since its n_12 derivative is positive, and each level has a unique equilibrium obtained by inverting H(E_s). In coordinates subtracting this equilibrium on the level, the other four variables have a strictly Hurwitz linearization, yielding local exponential convergence by the stable-equilibrium estimate, uniformly near compact portions using an extension along the open curve. This does not require trapping the limit in any prechosen closed subsegment if the initial H lies outside its image.
residual_risks: Only balanced mixing with the stipulated payoff differences and exact resonance is covered. Equal-response nonhyperbolicity gives no nonlinear periodic-orbit or asymptotic-stability conclusion.

value.rationale: The symmetry-reduced attractor can obscure a full-system undamped pair. The resonance family and balanced mixing are meaningful precisely because the equilibria form a curve and strategy damping has rank one. Classifying when environmental response asymmetry transfers that damping to all transverse modes closes a specific stability gap in the full model, with an exact conserved quantity predicting the local limiting point rather than merely convergence to a set.
residual_risks: Not a global basin result, an off-resonance classification, or a nonlinear classification at equal feedback.
